remarks:
This 5 acre building lot (lot 12) would be a beautiful spot to build your new home or cabin in Belfast NY, Allegany County.

The land is all hardwoods. The terrain is a mixture of flat land and some rolling hills, with an excellent area to park a camper or build a home or cabin.  There is 200 feet of road frontage with electric located at the road. There is an old driveway that needs to be reworked in-order to drive onto property.  There is Owner Financing available with 10% down, 10% APR and up to a 10 year term. This is a beautiful lot with privacy and seclusion from the road. More acreage is available upon request. All rights convey.

This property is located approximately 5 minutes to downtown Belfast NY, 13 minutes to Rushford Lake, 18 minutes to Cuba NY, 31 minutes to Hornell NY, 1 hour to Batavia NY, and 1 hour 20 minutes to Rochester NY and Buffalo NY.
